name: EM FX Carry-to-Vol Monthly Ranking: BRL, MXN, ZAR
description: Monthly cross-sectional ranking of BRL, MXN, ZAR by carry-to-vol ratio (short-term rate differential vs USD / 30-day realized FX vol). At each month-end, currencies are ranked 1-3 by carry-to-vol (highest = rank 1). Next-month FX returns are compared for the top-ranked vs bottom-ranked currency. Cumulative return chart shows compounding of a strategy that holds the top carry-to-vol currency long and shorts the bottom each month. FRED series: Brazil (INTGSTBRM193N), Mexico (INTGSTMXM193N), South Africa (INTGSTZAM193N), US (DFF). IMF IFS Treasury Bill rates used for EM — deep history back to 1960s+. FX convention: USDBRL/USDMXN/USDZAR — returns inverted so positive = EM currency appreciation.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM FX CARRY-TO-VOL MONTHLY RANKING: BRL, MXN, ZAR vs USD
# =============================================================================
# Signal: (EM short-term rate - US Fed Funds) / 30d annualized FX vol
# Rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol (most attractive), Rank 3 = lowest
# Compare next-month FX returns for top vs bottom ranked currency
# FX convention: USDBRL/USDMXN/USDZAR → invert returns so positive = EM appreciation
# =============================================================================

# --- FX Price Data (per-asset context) ---
src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c

# --- Interest Rate Data (shared context, same across all assets) ---
# IMF IFS Treasury Bill rates — deep history back to 1960s/1970s
br_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="INTGSTBRM193N")()
mx_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="INTGSTMXM193N")()
za_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="INTGSTZAM193N")()
us_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="DFF", use_alfred=False)()

# Forward-fill rates to daily (FRED publishes sparsely)
br_rate = ffill(br_rate_raw.result)
mx_rate = ffill(mx_rate_raw.result)
za_rate = ffill(za_rate_raw.result)
us_rate = ffill(us_rate_raw.result)

# --- Assign Correct EM Rate to Each Asset Context ---
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDBRL")()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDMXN")()
em_rate = conditional_select(is_brl, br_rate, is_mxn, mx_rate, za_rate)

# --- Carry: EM rate minus US rate (both in percentage points) ---
carry = em_rate - us_rate

# --- 30-Day Realized FX Volatility (annualized, in percentage points) ---
daily_ret = returns()(close_fx)
vol_30d = volatility(period=30)(close_fx)
vol_30d_pct = vol_30d * 100.0

# --- Carry-to-Vol Ratio ---
carry_to_vol = carry / vol_30d_pct

# =============================================================================
# DOWNSAMPLE TO MONTHLY
# =============================================================================

monthly_close = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(close_fx)
monthly_ctv = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(carry_to_vol)

# Next-month FX return (inverted: positive = EM appreciation vs USD)
fwd_1m_ret_raw = forward_returns(period=1)(monthly_close)
fwd_1m_ret = -1.0 * fwd_1m_ret_raw

# =============================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL RANKING (ascending=False → highest carry-to-vol = rank 1)
# =============================================================================

rank = cs_rank(ascending=False)(monthly_ctv)

# Filter returns by rank
is_top = rank == 1
is_bottom = rank == 3

top_ret = where(is_top, fwd_1m_ret)
bottom_ret = where(is_bottom, fwd_1m_ret)

# Hit rates: positive next-month return when ranked top/bottom
top_positive = where(is_top, 1.0 if fwd_1m_ret > 0 else 0.0)
bottom_positive = where(is_bottom, 1.0 if fwd_1m_ret > 0 else 0.0)

# Pre-scale returns to percentage points for table display (avoids PercentFormat double-scaling)
top_ret_pct = where(is_top, fwd_1m_ret * 100.0)
bottom_ret_pct = where(is_bottom, fwd_1m_ret * 100.0)

# =============================================================================
# CUMULATIVE RETURNS FOR CHART
# =============================================================================
# cumulative(Sum) on sparse per-asset series; cs_lines agg=Sum aggregates across assets
# Since exactly one asset is rank 1 each month, summing gives the portfolio return

cum_top = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(top_ret)
cum_bottom = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(bottom_ret)

# Monthly timestamp for x-axis
monthly_ts = downsample(target_timeframe=1M, how=NumericDownsampleAgg.last)(index())

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD: Cumulative Return — Top Rank vs Bottom Rank
# =============================================================================

cs_lines(
    title="Cumulative Next-Month Returns: Top vs Bottom Carry-to-Vol Rank",
    category="Carry-to-Vol Ranking",
    y_axis_label="Cumulative Return",
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Slate],
    dash_style=DashStyle.Solid,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Zero", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=monthly_ts, y_values=(cum_top, cum_bottom))

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD: Per-Currency Summary Table
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title="Carry-to-Vol Ranking: Per-Currency Breakdown",
    category="Carry-to-Vol Ranking",
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Per-Currency Carry-to-Vol Stats",
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Months Ranked #1", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Return When #1 (%)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Hit Rate When #1", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Months Ranked #3", type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title="Avg Return When #3 (%)", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title="Hit Rate When #3", type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    order=1
)(top_ret_pct, top_ret_pct, top_positive, bottom_ret_pct, bottom_ret_pct, bottom_positive)
